bullets.text: In Pallikaranai, a plumber died and another became critical after falling into a septic tank while clearing a drainage blockage.
Chief Minister Vijay laid the foundation stone for the Rs 3,108 crore Chennai ring main drinking water supply project.
Two youngsters were arrested in Besant Nagar for attacking a security guard with a knife following a harassment complaint.
Vanathi Srinivasan and opposition critics condemned the government over the reduction of the Pallikaranai wetland buffer zone.
CUMTA proposed detailed project reports for model mobility corridors transforming Taramani Link Road and other key stretches.
Wrong-side driving continues unabated on Chennai roads, including school zones in Velachery, endangering pedestrians and motorists.
Heavy overnight rains in Gummidipoondi caused severe waterlogging and flooded roads across the area.
Minister M. Vijay Balaji inspected monsoon preparedness works and inaugurated a new animal birth control centre in Athipattu.
The National Green Tribunal directed Avadi Corporation to stop solid waste and sewage from polluting the Cooum River.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay inaugurated CapitaLand's mega data centre in Ambattur alongside Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong.
NITI Aayog introduced a data centre evaluation framework urging states to verify power, water, and public value before backing projects.
Infosys CEO announced that artificial intelligence will handle about 50 percent of the company's work in the next two to three years.
The DMK revived the BJP B-team charge by comparing a famous hand gesture made by actor-politician Vijay to an RSS salute.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay inspected flood prevention works and the Okkiyam Maduvu canal area in Thoraipakkam ahead of the monsoon.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay launched the Rs 3,108.55 crore ring main pipeline system to interlink water sources in Chennai.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Chennai to inaugurate the 14.5 km metro rail service between Poonamallee and Vadapalani.
